phases.objective: Preserve one shared generated-artifact mutation owner while allowing multiple pending GitHub Actions runs to wait instead of silently replacing an older pending lifecycle.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A main push or manual trigger that starts OpenAPI Auto Sync, Surface Contract Auto Remediation, and Docs Agent work in the same governed concurrency group
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every admitted generated-artifact run retains the shared serialization key, cannot cancel in-progress work, and can wait in the bounded multi-pending queue instead of replacing another pending run.
steps: Load the repository-generated-artifacts resource-group policy and its three registered workflows.
Require every registered writer to use the exact shared repository/ref concurrency identity.
Require cancel-in-progress=false for every registered writer.
Require queue=max for every registered writer so simultaneous generated-artifact triggers can remain pending together.
Run the focused automation-overlap regression against the candidate tree.
assertions: OpenAPI Auto Sync retains the shared generated-artifact concurrency group and queue=max.
Surface Contract Auto Remediation retains the shared generated-artifact concurrency group and queue=max.
Docs Agent retains the shared generated-artifact concurrency group and queue=max.
The policy declares required_queue=max for repository-generated-artifacts.
No protected-branch write, force push, provider call, database mutation, deployment, or Production action is introduced by this queue contract.

phases.objective: Fail regression coverage when any governed shared generated-artifact writer drops its multi-pending queue or diverges from the declared serialization contract.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A pull request changing generated-artifact workflows, overlap policy, or focused overlap tests
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The candidate is rejected if a registered repository-generated-artifact writer can again use GitHub Actions' single-pending replacement behavior.
steps: Read the declared required_queue value from the governed resource group.
Read each registered workflow source from the same candidate tree.
Assert the exact concurrency group, cancel-in-progress=false, and queue=max contract for all three workflows.
Run the existing real-repository automation overlap analysis and require zero blocking findings.
assertions: The queue ratchet is candidate-local and does not rely on historical run state.
The regression covers all three registered repository-generated-artifact workflows.
The existing Work Map writer queue=max ratchet remains intact.

phases.objective: This repository concurrency contract has no provider canary authority.
This repository concurrency contract performs no Production action or deployment.
